name: Mira, Rift-Twin
text: Mira is Rumi's battle-sister, mirror duelist, and second blade in the violet breach. Passive team bond: if the operative is Rumi, gain +1 Signal and +1 Guile while Mira is following.

activeEffect.text: Mira reads the second angle: record a violet-route note for this duel, test, or movement choice.

acquisition: Drawn from the Artifact deck as Rumi's legendary companion bond.
Awarded by a Hollow Court duel or violet breach event.
Recovered after Rumi clears a Signal or Guile threat without taking a wound.
flavor: Rumi cuts the first future. Mira waits in the second.
imagePrompt: A grimdark fantasy-sci-fi companion card showing a violet-haired riftblade duelist in black thorn armor, pink-violet breach flame in one hand, jagged magenta signal sword in the other, standing in a ruined gothic-industrial battlefield under burning towers. She feels like the battle-sister and mirror partner of Rumi, elegant and dangerous, dark brass, violet rift light, cinematic Ashen Reach card art, no text.
